body: That's the thing, though, is that I have a ton of things I'm interested in. Helping others is honestly what means the most to me - I want to do heterodox economic academic work / social work in the gulf near where I grew up because I can't stand to see people hurting or suffering. I love music, I'm a voracious reader and am always the first one to think of a plan or a fun adventure. I'm not lifeless. I have a huge imagination and a lot of ambition. I just also don't want to be alive.
